description: Write what someone needs to know into a project. With no `document`, a new one: `name` and `body`. With `document`, change it: `body` with the `version` read_document gave you (a newer edit is refused, so nobody's writing is lost) and/or `name` to rename it, and/or `move_to` another project in the same space. Its id and history stay. Update the page that already covers something rather than adding another. A document has no owner and no state and tells nobody: anything someone must still act on is work (create_work).

document.description: the document to change; leave out for a new one

move_to.description: a project id in the same space to move it into

name.description: its name: required for a new one, a rename otherwise

version.description: with `body` on an existing document: the version you read

name: save_document
title: Save a document
